source_evidence: For accepted orders the warehouse picks the parts, packs the order and books a carrier.
problem: The warehouse department is marked authority="authority", assigning its work to an automated system instead of a human department.
correction: Change Lane_warehouse aef:laneMeta authority from "authority" to "sovereignty".

source_evidence:
The warehouse also does quality inspection and labelling for each order, but nobody could
say whether those happen before or after packing, or in which order relative to each other.
problem: Quality inspection is placed between picking and packing even though the source explicitly leaves its order relative to packing unknown.
correction: Remove pick-parts--quality-inspection and quality-inspection--pack-order and their incoming/outgoing references, restore a direct pick-parts-to-pack-order sequence flow, and leave quality-inspection unconnected with an associated annotation declaring its unknown order relative to packing and labelling.

problem: The map adds an ERP payment-reminder task after invoicing and supports it with a fabricated source quotation about sending a reminder after seven days.
correction: Remove send-payment-reminder, its fabricated documentation, its Lane_erp reference and both incident sequence flows; connect generate-and-send-invoice directly to accepted-order-fulfilled and update the incoming/outgoing references.
